section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) with 143 undergraduate women who completed self-reports on exercise behavior, body orientation, body appreciation, and body-related talk. The study examined how conversations about weight loss/dieting versus exercise differentially predicted body appreciation, with results showing that exercise conversations operated through an object orientation (what bodies can do), while weight loss conversations operated through negative body attitudes.
